description.narrative: TICASEP aims to advance energy efficiency in Tanzania by building strategic partnerships, system strengthening, and innovation. It addressed issues of unsustainable energy consumption, insufficient energy supply for Tanzania’s fast-growing population, and the need to reduce greenhouse gases emissions. The programme will support the establishment of the Energy Efficiency Unit within the Ministry of Energy to strengthen coordination and implementation; facilitate institutional partnerships between Tanzanian and Ireland for knowledge exchange and capacity development; and facilitate stakeholder policy dialogues and applied research. It will also award scholarships to 10 young women to study Masters in sustainable energy engineering and initiate an energy efficiency hackathon to crowdsource ideas and pilot promising innovations.
